description: Grows with its content, or resizes by dragging. Optional character counter. Works with Livewire wire:model.

consider.note: `maxlength` and the counter only guide typing. Add `max:` in your Form Request too, or one request can store megabytes in a column you load on every page.
Show it back with `{{ }}`. If you turn it into Markdown or HTML, sanitise the result first: what people write ends up in other people's browsers.
